sentenceSets.sentence: His reputation for unimpeachable integrity made the allegation implausible and the investigation necessary.

answerChoices.reasoning: Impeccable means faultless; unimpeachable specifically means not able to be questioned or attacked, which impeccable can be but focuses on lack of fault.
Irreproachable means beyond reproach; unimpeachable emphasizes beyond questioning or attack, which reproachable addresses but from a different angle.
Inviolable means not able to be broken or violated; unimpeachable specifically means not able to be questioned or disputed.
Unquestionable means beyond question; unimpeachable is very similar, emphasizing not able to be challenged or attacked.
Pristine means pure and untainted; unimpeachable emphasizes not able to be questioned or attacked, not just purity.
Spotless means without any fault or blemish; unimpeachable emphasizes not able to be questioned, not just absence of fault.
Flawless means without defects; unimpeachable emphasizes not able to be questioned or attacked in court of opinion.
Unblemished means without marks or blemishes; unimpeachable emphasizes not able to be questioned or challenged.
Questionable means able to be disputed or doubted, the opposite of unimpeachable, which cannot be questioned.
Suspicious means seeming questionable, the opposite of unimpeachable, which is beyond question.
Impeachable means able to be questioned or challenged, the direct opposite of unimpeachable.
